failures.result: The first certificate source reaches the local-radius sweep then raises TypeError because Arb does not directly compare to Python Fraction. No certificate JSON is emitted. Separate v2 compares against an Arb enclosure of 1/2; all scientific formulas and input files remain unchanged.

The first proof uses the reserved Lean keyword prefix as a binder. Five lemmas check, but the compilation fails and no successful artifact is claimed. Separate v2 renames that binder and all six lemmas compile.

source_policy: Executed source versions and failures remain immutable. The final recursive verifier runs after packaging and preserves its own external receipt. Its exact stdout becomes Verification.json.
runtime: No package acquisition, version changes or new source roots. Existing pinned Python, FLINT and Lean/mathlib environments are reused.
shared_infrastructure: Independent real and complex formulations share FLINT and inherited source premises. Exact rational inclusions and modular determinants provide distinct arithmetic routes.
